canonical_repository.name: 7guard-io/7ya.io
canonical_repository.role: only canonical source-control and review plane

principles: A plan is not an outcome

canonical_release.scope: Creatorverse homepage plus human-first StartOn, Evidence and Talk depth pages

active_change.purpose: Replace the legacy Contact shell and codify the canonical Vercel recovery deployment
active_change.head_resolution_rule: Read the live PR head from GitHub; do not store a self-referential SHA in this file

deployment.known_runtime_content_gap: Contact is operational but still serves the legacy shell until PR #191 is merged and the proxy source SHA is advanced

obsolete_or_misaligned_project.name: 7ya.io
obsolete_or_misaligned_project.policy: Do not treat this project or repository as canonical

deployment.public_domain_alignment: 7ya.io has not been cut over to the verified canonical recovery alias

ci.cause: organization account locked due to a billing issue
ci.interpretation: No workflow run is not a code PASS and not a code FAIL

release_blockers: PR #191 must be reviewed, merged and deployed
The recovery proxy SHA must be advanced to the PR #191 merge commit
The new Contact page must pass runtime verification
The custom 7ya.io domain is not attached to the canonical recovery project
The public domain has not been verified against the canonical recovery source SHA
next_safe_gate: Deploy ops/vercel-canonical-proxy with the new merge SHA
Verify the new /contact/ page and the complete route contract
Attach 7ya.io and www.7ya.io to the canonical recovery project before changing Cloudflare web records
Preserve the previous origin until DNS, TLS and route verification pass

dns_policy.rule: Do not change nameservers; preserve all mail-related MX and TXT records

privacy_boundary: No private family, medical, legal or financial information
No raw private emails, credentials, tokens or account codes
No operational security methods or protected case information
